from state import Config

def test_set_invalidates_cache():
    c = Config()
    assert c.get("a") is None
    c.set("a", 1)
    assert c.get("a") == 1
    c.set("a", 2)
    assert c.get("a") == 2

def test_default_not_sticky():
    c = Config()
    assert c.get("a", 5) == 5
    c.set("a", 7)
    assert c.get("a") == 7
